entities.name: Table T1 – Global Fund Flows Foreign Flows into US Equity Funds by Domicile
entities.brief: Foreign flows by domicile into US equity funds (4wma)
entities.description: Tracks 4-week moving average foreign inflows from Euro area and Rest of world ex. US, highlighting peaks in late 2024 and reversal in Q2 2025

properties.key_insight: Euro area flows peaked at +8.1bn in late Nov 2024 and Rest of world ex. US peaked at +3.0bn in Jan 2025 before both turned negative in Q2 2025

entities.name: Table T2 – Global Fund Flows Flows into Cyclical vs Defensive Equity Funds
entities.brief: 4wma cyclical vs defensive equity fund flows
entities.description: Shows 4-week moving average flows for Cyclicals ex. Tech and Defensives, highlighting peaks, troughs, and divergence through July 2025

properties.key_insight: Cyclical flows peaked at +2.6bn in late Nov 2024 and troughed at -3.4bn in early May 2025 while defensive flows remained near zero with a modest peak of +0.5bn in mid-Mar 2025
